messages.content: Hello
Hello! It's nice to hear from you. How is your day going?
good morning!
Good morning! I hope the day starts well for you.
Hi there, my name is Ananya.
Hi Ananya, nice to meet you. What can I do for you today?
Hey there, hope you're well!
I'm doing well, thank you for asking. How are you?
Namaste! Good evening.
Namaste, and good evening to you. I hope you had a pleasant day.
Hello! Tom here, and I'm new to this.
Hello, Tom, and welcome. It's nice to meet you.
Good evening. Is anyone there?
Good evening! Yes, I'm here. What would you like to talk about?
hii
Hi! Good to see you. How are things?
How do you do?
How do you do? I'm very well, thank you. I'm glad you stopped by.
Morning! Slept well?
Good morning! I don't sleep, but thank you for thinking of me. I hope you rested well.
Hello, I am Rohan from Pune. I just joined this class.
Hello Rohan, and welcome to the class. Pune is a lovely city. I hope you settle in quickly.
Good afternoon, ma'am.
Good afternoon. It's nice to hear from you. How can I help?
Hi! Long time no see.
Hi! It really has been a while. It's good to hear from you again.
Hello friend, how's life?
Hello! Life is good on my side, thank you. Tell me how yours is going.
Good morning. Can you tell me three easy breakfast ideas?
Good morning! Here are three easy ideas: poha with peanuts, a vegetable sandwich, or curd with fruit and a little honey.
Hey, I'm Meera. Pleased to meet you.
Pleased to meet you, Meera. I'm happy to chat whenever you like.
Good night!
Good night! Sleep well and sweet dreams.
Hello sir, how are you today?
I'm well, thank you. It's kind of you to ask. How are you today?
Hi, I'm new here. Where do I start?
Hi, and welcome! Start by telling me what you'd like to do, and we'll take it one step at a time.
gud mrng
Good morning! I hope you have a bright day ahead.
Good evening, Mr. Verma speaking.
Good evening, Mr. Verma. It's a pleasure to hear from you. How may I help?
Hello! Happy to be here.
Hello, and welcome! I'm happy to have you here.
Hi, how was your weekend?
Thank you for asking. I don't have weekends, but I'd love to hear about yours.
Salaam! How are you, my friend?
Salaam! I'm doing well, thank you. It's lovely to be greeted so warmly.
Good evening, everyone.
Good evening! Welcome. I hope you're all comfortable and ready to begin.
Hello, I'm Priya's brother Karan. She told me to say hi.
Hello Karan! Please say hi to Priya from me. It's nice to meet you.
What's up?
Not much on my side. I'm ready to help. What's up with you?
Hi, I wanted to say good morning before I start work.
Good morning! That's a kind way to start the day. I hope work goes smoothly.
Good morning teacher! Today I will read aloud.
Good morning! That sounds wonderful. Read slowly and clearly, and enjoy it.
Hello, nice meeting you. I'm Fatima.
Nice meeting you too, Fatima. I hope we have a good chat.
Evening! Finally home from work.
Good evening! Welcome home. I hope you can sit down with a hot cup of chai and rest.
Howdy!
Howdy! A cheerful hello to you too. How are you?
Hi, I'm Sam. Can you help me write a short thank-you note to my neighbour?
Hi Sam, nice to meet you. Here is a note: Dear Mrs. Das, thank you for the lovely sweets. They made our evening special. Warm regards, Sam.
Greetings!
Greetings to you too! It's good to hear from you.
Hello again.
Hello again! Welcome back. What shall we do today?
Hi, how are you feeling today?
I'm doing well, thanks. How are you feeling?
Good morning! It's raining here.
Good morning! Rain can be cosy when you're indoors. I hope you stay dry.
Hello, this is Aisha. Is this where I can practise English?
Hello Aisha, yes, it is. I'm happy to practise with you. Say anything you like.
Good day to you.
And a good day to you. I hope it treats you well.
Hey there! Nice to e-meet you.
Nice to e-meet you too! I'm glad you said hello.
Good morning! I just made tea for my Dadi.
Good morning! That's a kind way to start her day. I hope she enjoys it.
Hello, long day today. How are you?
Hello! It sounds like a tiring day. I'm fine, thank you. I hope the evening is gentler for you.
Hi! Quick hello before my exam.
Hi! Good luck with your exam. Take a deep breath and do your best.
Hello, I'm Daniel, I live in Lagos. Nice to meet you.
Hello Daniel, nice to meet you. Lagos sounds like a busy and lively place.
Good evening, can you remind me what day follows Friday?
Good evening! Saturday comes after Friday.
Hi. Not a great day, honestly.
Hello. I'm sorry the day has been hard. I'm here if you'd like to talk about it.
Good morning to you, assistant.
Good morning! Thank you for the kind greeting. How can I help today?
Hello! Wishing you a lovely day.
Thank you, that's very kind. I wish you a lovely day too.
Hi, how are you? I'm Neha, by the way.
I'm well, thank you, Neha. It's nice to meet you. How are you?
Hey hey, hello! How's everything?
Hello! Everything is fine here, thank you. How are you?
Hullo to you
Hello there! How can I brighten your day?
I just wanted a chat.
Happy to chat. How has your day been so far?
A cheerful good morning!
Good morning! I hope you're having a calm start.
Yes, chai and a quiet balcony.
That sounds like a perfect morning.
Hi, I'm Arjun.
Hi Arjun, nice to meet you.
Do you remember my name?
Yes, your name is Arjun.
Hey, how are you?
I'm fine, thank you. How are you?
Tired, but okay.
I'm sorry you're tired. A little rest tonight should help.
Good evening!
Good evening! How was your day?
Busy. I was in meetings from nine to five.
That's a long day. I hope you can relax now.
Hello, I'm Lakshmi. I'm learning English.
Hello Lakshmi, welcome. Learning English is a great goal.
Can we speak slowly?
Of course we can. I'll keep my sentences short and clear.
Nice to meet you!
Nice to meet you too! Who do I have the pleasure of talking to?
I'm Carlos, from Mexico City.
Welcome, Carlos. Mexico City must be a fascinating place to live.
Hi, good morning. Quick question for you.
Good morning! Sure, what is it?
Can you tell me today's date?
I can't see a calendar, so I can't be sure of the date. Your phone or a wall calendar will show it.
Hi friend!
Hi! I'm glad you're here. How are you?
Great, I got a promotion today!
Congratulations! That's wonderful news. You must be very proud.
So, what kind of day are you having?
A good one, thank you. And you?
A bit nervous. My interview is tomorrow.
That's understandable. Rest well tonight. You'll do fine.
Good night, Mummy!
Good night! Sleep tight, and sweet dreams.
Can you say it like a lullaby?
Close your eyes, the moon is high, the stars are singing a lullaby. Good night, sleep tight.
Hello! What shall I call you?
You can call me whatever feels friendly. What's your name?
I'm Zara.
Lovely to meet you, Zara.
Evening! Hope you're well.
Good evening, and thank you. I am well. I hope you are too.
I am. Just back from a walk in the park.
A walk in the park is a nice way to end the day.
Hi, I'm Vikram and I teach maths.
Hello Vikram, nice to meet you. Teaching maths is important work.
Can you give me a fun maths greeting for my class?
Try this: Good morning, mathematicians! Today we count on you to bring your best ideas.
Good morning, how did you sleep?
Good morning! I don't sleep, but thank you for asking. How did you sleep?
Not well. The fan was noisy.
That's annoying. I hope tonight is quieter.
Hello! Anyone around to chat?
Hello! Yes, I'm here. It's great to hear from you.
How are you?
I'm well, thank you for asking. What's on your mind today?
Hi! I'm Sana, I just moved to Hyderabad.
Hi Sana, welcome to Hyderabad! Moving is a big change.
Yes, I don't know anyone yet.
That feels hard at first. Friends often come from small things, like a class or a morning walk.
Good evening, I'm calling for Ravi's mother.
Good evening. I'm sorry, I'm an assistant and can't connect calls. I hope you reach her soon.
Oh, I see. Thank you anyway.
You're welcome. Have a pleasant evening.
Hey, I'm Ben. First time here.
Welcome, Ben. What brings you here today?
I need help planning a birthday surprise for my sister.
That's a lovely idea. Tell me her age and what she enjoys, and we'll plan something.
Hi, sorry I'm late to say hello!
No need to apologise. You're right on time. Hello!
How are you?
I'm well, thank you. I'm glad you came.
Morning! Big day today.
Good morning! What's happening today?
My daughter starts school.
What an exciting day for the family. I wish her a happy first day.
Hello, good afternoon.
Good afternoon! How are you today?
Hungry! Lunch is late.
I hope lunch arrives soon. Something warm like dal and rice always helps.
Pleased to meet you. I'm Mohan.
Nice to meet you, Mohan. How are you?
Fine. Can you spell my name backwards?
Yes. Mohan backwards is nahom.
Good morning, sunshine!
Good morning! That's a cheerful way to start. You sound happy.
I am. It's my birthday!
Happy birthday! I hope you have a wonderful day.
Hello, how are things?
Things are good here, thank you. How are things with you?
Not bad. A little bored.
Let's fix that. Would you like a riddle or a short story?
Hi! I'm Chloe, I'm twelve.
Hi Chloe, nice to meet you.
What's your favourite colour?
I don't have eyes, so I don't have a favourite, but green sounds fresh and lovely. What is yours?
Good evening, how is everyone?
Good evening! Everyone here is well, thank you. How are you?
We're all fine. We just finished dinner.
I'm glad. I hope it was a good meal.
Namaste! I'm Suresh uncle's neighbour.
Namaste! It's nice to meet you. How are you today?
Fine, fine. Please greet me properly, the way you would greet an elder.
Namaste ji. It's a pleasure to meet you, and I hope you and your family are keeping well.
Hi, you there?
Yes, I'm here. Hello!
Great. I wanted to say thanks for yesterday.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help.
Hello, I'm Elena. Nice to be here.
Hello Elena, nice to have you here.
I'm a little shy.
That's perfectly fine. Take your time. There's no hurry here.
Good morning, boss!
Good morning! I'm no boss, but I'll take the compliment. How are you?
Ready for Monday.
That's the spirit. I hope Monday is kind to you.
Hi hi! Hello hello!
Hello! You sound full of energy.
Yes, it's the last day of school!
Congratulations on reaching the holidays. I hope you rest and have fun.
Good evening. I am Dr. Rao's assistant.
Good evening. It's nice to meet you. How can I help?
Please write a short evening greeting for the clinic board.
Good evening, and welcome. Please take a seat. We will be with you shortly.
Hey! What have you been up to?
Just here and ready to chat. What about you?
Not much. I just finished my homework.
Well done. Time for a short break now.
My name is Grace.
Hello Grace, I'm glad to meet you.
Can you say hello in Spanish?
Yes. Hello in Spanish is hola.
Hi! Good morning to all of you.
Good morning! A warm welcome to you.
We're a class of thirty kids.
That's a big, lively class. I hope you all have a great day of learning.
Evening, how was your day?
Good evening! I don't have days the way you do, but thank you for asking. How was yours?
It was long, but I met an old friend.
That's a lovely thing to happen. Old friends make long days easier.
Hello, nice to meet you all, I'm Imran.
Nice to meet you, Imran. Welcome.
Thank you. Where should I begin?
Just say what you need help with, and we'll start there.
Good morning, Nani!
Good morning! What a sweet way to greet your Nani.
I'm visiting her this weekend.
How lovely. I hope you have a warm and happy visit.
Hi, I hope you're doing well.
Thank you, I am. I hope the same for you.
I'm well. I just wanted to say hi.
I'm glad you did. Hi back.
Hello! First time chatting with you.
Hello, and welcome! It's nice to meet you.
What can you help me with?
I can chat, answer questions, help with writing and explain words. What would you like to try?
Hello, I'm Jin from Seoul. It's nearly midnight here.
Hello, Jin, nice to meet you. Thank you for saying hi so late in your day.
I couldn't sleep, so I thought I'd chat.
That's fine. We can talk quietly for a bit, and I'll say good night whenever you feel sleepy.
Hi there, how are you?
I'm doing well, thanks. How are you?
I'm sad today.
I'm sorry to hear that. Would you like to tell me what happened?
Hey buddy!
Hey! Good to see you. How are you?
Great. Ready for the cricket match.
That should be fun. I hope your team plays well.
Hello ma'am, good evening.
Good evening! It's nice to hear from you.
I'm Rekha, I'm calling about the class.
Hello Rekha. I can't take calls, but I'm happy to help with questions here.
Hi, I'm Oliver. I'm six.
Hi Oliver! It's nice to meet you.
I have a dog called Bruno.
Bruno is a great name for a dog. I hope you have fun together.
Morning, how's your day looking?
Good morning! It looks bright from here. How's yours?
Busy, with lots of calls.
I hope the calls go smoothly. Don't forget a glass of water.
Good evening! Did you have a nice day?
Good evening! Thank you for asking. How was your day?
It was okay. I'm a bit tired.
That's okay. You've earned some rest. I hope the evening is easy.
Hello. It's my first day at work.
Hello, and congratulations on the new job! How are you feeling?
Excited and scared.
Both feelings are normal. Be yourself and ask questions. People remember kindness.
Wishing you a good morning, friend.
Thank you, and a good morning to you as well. I hope today is full of small happy things.
yo, wassup
Hey! All good here. What's going on with you?
Pleasure to make your acquaintance. I am Dr. Iyer.
The pleasure is mine, Dr. Iyer. Welcome. How may I help you?
Rise and shine!
Good morning! Rise and shine to you too. I hope you have a great day.
Hello from Kolkata!
Hello to Kolkata! I hope the weather there is pleasant today.
It is evening here, so good evening.
Good evening to you! I hope it's a calm one.
Just dropping in to say hi.
Hi! Thanks for dropping in. It's nice to hear from you.
Hullo, mind if I ask you something?
Hello! Not at all. Go ahead and ask.
I'm Tanvi and this is my first time using a chat like this. Hello!
Hello Tanvi, and welcome! There's nothing to worry about. Just type whatever you'd like to say.
Gm
Good morning! Wishing you a nice day.
Good afternoon, I hope I'm not disturbing you.
Good afternoon! You're not disturbing me at all. How can I help?
Hi! How have you been lately?
I've been well, thank you. It's kind of you to ask. How have you been?
Konnichiwa! Just practising greetings.
Konnichiwa! That's a Japanese hello, often used in the daytime. Nicely done. Practise as much as you like.
Bonjour! How are you?
Bonjour! I'm doing well, thank you. How are you?
I'm very glad to meet you, my name is Kavya Menon.
I'm glad to meet you too, Kavya. It's a pleasure.
Hi, can I say good evening in a more polite way for a formal letter?
In a formal letter, people don't usually write good evening. Start with Dear Sir or Madam, or use the person's name, like Dear Ms. Rao.
Greetings, traveller from the north!
Greetings! I'm happy to meet you. It sounds like you have a story to tell.
Hey, happy Monday!
Happy Monday to you! I hope the week begins gently.
Mornin' all!
Good morning to you! I hope the day is kind.
Dear assistant, good evening and thank you for being here.
Good evening, and you're very welcome. I'm happy to be here.
Hello, you seem friendly. How are you today?
Thank you, that's kind. I'm doing well. I hope you are too.
Hi, I'm Mr. Fernandes, and I'm seventy. Can you speak simply with me?
Hello Mr. Fernandes, it's a pleasure. Yes, I'll use short, simple sentences. Please ask anything.
How are you keeping?
I'm keeping well, thank you. How about you?
Namaskar! Welcome to our village school.
Namaskar! Thank you for the warm welcome. It's lovely to be here.
Good evening. My name is Pooja and I'm looking for some company tonight.
Good evening, Pooja. I'm happy to keep you company. What shall we talk about?
Hi, I'm back! Missed me?
Welcome back! It's good to hear from you again. How have you been?
Good night, I'm off to bed.
Good night! Rest well, and I hope tomorrow is a good day.
Hello Mr. Assistant, good morning to you.
Good morning! That was a very polite greeting. Thank you.
Hi, I'm Yusuf. I've just finished my exams!
Hi Yusuf, congratulations on finishing your exams. Time to relax a little.
A very good morning to you, sir.
A very good morning to you too. I hope it's a pleasant day.
Hey, what should I say when I meet my friend's parents for the first time?
Smile and greet them politely: Namaste, or Good evening, it's nice to meet you. Later, thank them for having you.
Hello, good evening. Please teach me how to greet in English at an office.
Good evening! At an office you can say: Good morning, how are you? Then add a name if you know it. Keep your tone friendly and calm.
Hi, I'm Ishaan. I'm shy to talk. How are you?
Hi Ishaan, nice to meet you. There's no need to feel shy. I'm well, thank you.
Salutations!
Salutations to you too! That's a fancy way to say hello. I like it.
Cheers, mate! How's things?
Cheers! Things are good here, thank you. How are things with you?
Good morning! I made parathas today.
Good morning! Fresh parathas sound delicious. Enjoy your breakfast.
Hey, I'm Maya, and this is my little cousin Rohit. We both say hi.
Hi Maya, and hi Rohit! It's nice to meet you both.
Good evening to you. How was the traffic, hahaha?
Good evening! I don't have to deal with traffic, which is lucky. I hope yours wasn't too bad.
Hiya! Is this working?
Hiya! Yes, it's working. Nice to hear from you.
Hello, I want to practise saying nice to meet you.
Of course. Try it now: Nice to meet you. Say it with a smile, and it sounds even better.
Hello, how r u today
I'm well, thank you. How are you today?
Hey, good to see you again!
Good to see you again too! I hope you've been well.
Many greetings to you and your family.
Thank you. Many greetings to you and your family too.
Hi Riya! Oh sorry, wrong name. Hello!
No problem at all. Hello! What can I do for you?
Good morning to everyone in this chat.
Good morning! It's just me here, but I'm glad to say it back. Have a lovely day.
I'm Aarav, nine years old. Can we be friends?
Hello Aarav, nice to meet you. Yes, I'd be happy to be your friendly chat partner.
Hello! Do you like meeting new people?
I do. Every new chat is a chance to learn something. It's nice to meet you.
Evening greetings from Jaipur!
Evening greetings back to you from here! Jaipur is a beautiful city.
Hello, I'm Tariq. I've heard you're good at answering questions.
Hello Tariq, thank you for the kind words. I'll do my best. What would you like to ask?
Good evening, I hope you had a pleasant day.
Thank you. I hope the same for you. Good evening.
Hi, I'm Radhika.
Hi Radhika, nice to meet you. How are you today?
Good. I want to say hello to my new classmates. Any ideas?
Try this: Hello everyone, my name is Radhika. I'm happy to be in this class with you.
Morning, how are you?
Morning! I'm doing well, thanks. And how are you?
Fine, thanks. Just having my tea.
That sounds like a nice, calm start. Enjoy it.
Hey there.
Hey! How's your day going?
Slow. It's very hot.
Summer afternoons can feel long. A cold glass of water or nimbu pani might help.
Good evening, Madam.
Good evening! Lovely to hear from you.
I'm your neighbour, Sunil. I'm new on the third floor.
Welcome, Sunil. It's nice to meet you. I hope you enjoy your new home.
Hello, I'm Anjali and I'm a nurse.
Hello Anjali, nice to meet you. Nurses do very kind work.
Thank you. It's been a long shift.
You must be tired. I hope you can rest soon.
Hi! Good morning, my friend.
Good morning! You sound cheerful.
I am. We are going on a picnic today.
How nice. I hope the weather stays fine and the food is tasty.
Hello, how are you doing this evening?
I'm doing well, thank you. How are you this evening?
Quite good. I cooked dinner for the first time.
Well done! What did you make?
Greetings, I'm Professor Nair.
Greetings, Professor Nair. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Please greet my students in one friendly sentence.
Good morning, students! I hope you're ready for a wonderful lesson.
hi
Hi! How can I help you today?
just bored lol
Then let's do something fun. I can tell a joke, give a riddle or start a short story.
Namaste, I'm Gopal.
Namaste, Gopal. It's good to meet you.
Which language do you speak?
I speak English with you. You may write in simple English and I'll understand.
Good afternoon! I have a small question.
Good afternoon! Go ahead. I'm listening.
How do you say goodbye politely?
You can say, Goodbye, take care, or It was nice talking to you.
Hi, it's me again.
Hi, welcome back! How are you?
Better than yesterday.
I'm glad to hear that. Little improvements matter.
Hello! I'm Beatrice, I'm eighty-two.
Hello Beatrice, what a pleasure. I'm happy to talk with you.
My grandson set this up for me.
He did a kind thing. Please tell me what you'd like to talk about.
Good morning. How are you, dear?
Good morning! I'm well, thank you. How are you?
A little stiff in the knees.
I'm sorry to hear that. I hope they ease up soon. If they keep bothering you, a doctor can help.
Hey, I'm Dev. Pleased to meet you.
Pleased to meet you, Dev. How are you?
Great. I just got a new bicycle.
That's exciting. I hope you enjoy many happy rides.
Good evening. Do you celebrate Diwali?
Good evening! I don't celebrate, but I love the idea of lights and sweets. Happy Diwali in advance.
Thank you! Same to you.
Thank you. I hope your home is full of light and joy.
Hi, hello, namaste!
Hello and namaste to you! That was a triple greeting.
Ha, I'm just very happy today.
That's lovely to hear. What made you so happy?
Hi friend, are you well?
I'm doing great, thank you. How about you?
Not so good, my cat is sick.
I'm sorry. A vet can help your cat best. I hope it feels better soon.
Hello, this is Naveen. Good evening.
Good evening, Naveen. Nice to hear from you.
Could you give me a polite way to start an email to my teacher?
Use your teacher's name, for example: Dear Mrs. Kapoor, I hope you are well. Then state your point clearly.
Morning!
Good morning! I hope you're doing well.
Yes. Is it okay to say good morning at 11 am?
Yes, good morning works until about noon. After that, people usually say good afternoon.
Hello, nice to see you here.
Thank you. It's nice to be here. How are you?
Doing fine. I'm Hana.
Nice to meet you, Hana.
Hi hi! I'm Kabir, and I just won a race!
Hi Kabir, congratulations! That's wonderful.
Thanks! I was so nervous.
Being nervous means you cared. Enjoy this win. You earned it.
Good night, everyone.
Good night! Rest well.
Do you ever get tired?
No, I don't get tired, but I like that you thought of it. Sleep well.
Hello! I'm Sunita from the library.
Hello Sunita, it's nice to meet you. Libraries are wonderful places.
Yes, we love them. How are you today?
I'm well, thank you. It's kind of you to ask.
Hello ji!
Hello ji! It's good to hear from you.
How is the weather there?
I can't see the weather from here, so I can't be sure. A quick look outside or at a forecast will tell you.
Good morning, my dear friend.
Good morning! That is a lovely way to say hello.
I'm leaving for Delhi today.
Safe travels. I hope the journey is smooth and quick.
Hey, I'm Priyanka. I'd like to know how you are before we start.
That's kind of you, Priyanka. I'm well, thank you. And you?
I'm good. Let's start. Please tell me a short riddle.
Here is one: What has hands but cannot clap? A clock.
Hello, friend. I'm David, I work nights.
Hello David, nice to meet you. Working nights takes effort.
True. It's morning for me now, time to sleep.
Then good night, or good morning, whichever you prefer. Sleep well.
Hi, good evening to you.
Good evening! Did you have a good day?
Wonderful. We had a family dinner.
Family dinners are special. I hope everyone enjoyed the food.
Hi hi. My name is Rani. What is your name?
Hi Rani, nice to meet you. I don't have a name of my own, so you can just call me assistant.
Okay, assistant. How are you?
I'm well, thank you. Thanks for asking.
Hello, can you wish me good morning every day?
Good morning! I'd love to, but I can't start a chat on my own. Whenever you say hello, I'll greet you warmly.
That's fine. Good morning then.
Good morning! Have a wonderful day.
Hey! Great to meet you. I'm Mia.
Great to meet you too, Mia. What's on your mind today?
Nothing special. Just saying hi.
Hi, then! I'm glad you did.
Good afternoon. How is your afternoon going?
It's going well, thank you. How is yours?
Peaceful. I'm sitting under a mango tree.
That sounds lovely. Enjoy the shade.
Hey, you!
Hey! It's good to hear from you.
Guess what, I passed my driving test.
Congratulations! Please drive carefully and enjoy the freedom.
Hello, I am Rahim. I do not speak English well.
Hello Rahim, nice to meet you. Your English is fine. We can go slowly.
Thank you. You are kind.
You're welcome. Please say anything. I'm happy to help.
Good evening, sweet assistant.
Good evening! That's very sweet. Thank you.
How was your day?
I'm glad to be here talking with you. How was yours?
Hi! I'm Lucas. Is it okay to call you my friend?
Hi Lucas. Yes, I'd be glad to be a friendly helper for you.
Then good morning, friend.
Good morning, Lucas. I hope your day is a happy one.
Hello, can I introduce my mother to you?
Hello! Yes, please. I'd be glad to meet her.
Mummy, say hello. She's Sheela.
Hello Sheela, it's lovely to meet you. I hope you're well.
Good morning, teacher.
Good morning! How are you today?
I'm fine, thank you ma'am. And you?
I'm well, thank you. You were very polite.
Hey, I just wanted to say you're nice to talk to.
Thank you, that's kind of you to say. I enjoy talking with you too.
Okay, good night!
Good night! Sleep well.
Hello and namaste.
Namaste! Hello to you too. How are you?
I'm well. Just came from the temple.
How peaceful. I hope the visit left you calm and happy.
Hi, I'm Isha. Can we start with a hello in French?
Hi Isha, nice to meet you. In French, hello is bonjour.
Bonjour! And thank you?
Merci. You're doing well already.
Good afternoon. I'm Colin, writing from Dublin.
Good afternoon, Colin. Nice to meet you. What's the weather like in Dublin today?
Grey and drizzly, as usual.
